page.content:
Wano Country is a country in the New World that is unaffiliated with the World Government. It is located on the north side of the New World, northwest of Egghead, southwest of Winner Island, and west of Elbaph.

page.overview:
What is Wano Country?

Wano Country is a country in the New World that is unaffiliated with the World Government. It is located on the north side of the New World, northwest of Egghead, southwest of Winner Island, and west of Elbaph.

It was previously occupied by the Beasts Pirates as their territory, under Kaidou, one of the Four Emperors. For a long time it was ruled by the Kouzuki Family, however, the family's usurper, Kurozumi Orochi, conspired to overthrow and supersede their shogunate with the aid of the Beasts Pirates 28 years before the present day. Upon his betrayal of the Kurozumi Family, Kaidou initiated his project to transform Wano into a lawless pirate paradise. However, Wano was liberated after the defeats of both Kaidou and Orochi in the Raid on Onigashima, and the Kouzuki Family was returned to power with Kouzuki Momonosuke as the current shogun. Before departing Wano, Monkey D. Luffy, the man who dethroned Kaidou, gave a copy of his Jolly Roger to Momonosuke to hang somewhere in the country and announced that if big trouble came, to point to the flag, implying that Wano is allied with and under the protection of the Straw Hat Pirates.

Hundreds of years ago, Wano was known as the , being once located at sea level. The Ancient Weapon Pluton is currently located under Mt. Fuji, beneath the old Wano Country.

First mentioned by Hogback during the Thriller Bark Arc, Wano is the primary setting of the Wano Country Arc.
